_note: Written by scripts/sync-puppies.mjs, never rebuilt from scratch: puppies that left the available list. status: placed (sold evidence; page stays up, noindex, "Found a loving home"), withdrawn (no evidence; no page, URL 301s to /puppies/), expired (past the 90-day retention; URL 301s). placedAt = the day the sync first saw it gone (SGT); lastListed = the last day it was listed. Do not hand-edit; to mark a sale, add the id to sold-overrides.json and re-run the sync.
